title: WAF Paranoia Level Evaluation
label: Featured · WAF Tuning
image_alt: Bar chart comparing PL1 and PL2 headline metrics: TPR identical at 97.0%, FPR doubled from 1.0% to 2.0%
metric: PL1 → PL2: detection unchanged (TPR 97.0%), false positives doubled (1.0% → 2.0%)
description: Tested ModSecurity CRS 3.3.8 at Paranoia Level 1 vs PL2 against structured SQLi and XSS payloads in a Docker-based reverse-proxy testbed. Every observed difference traced back to threshold arithmetic rather than additional rule logic: a practical argument against blindly raising paranoia levels in production. Built as my MSc dissertation (Distinction).

title: WAF Bypass Detection in Microsoft Sentinel
label: Featured · Detection Engineering
image_alt: Microsoft Sentinel Logs blade running the leftanti KQL bypass-detection query, with matching attack URIs in the results pane
metric: Rediscovered a boolean-blind SQLi bypass with a leftanti KQL join: HTTP 200, zero rule hits
description: Detection lab that ingests ModSecurity and NGINX logs into Microsoft Sentinel via the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API and surfaces attacks the WAF let through. Built on a custom dual-table schema, Data Collection Rules, a scoped Entra app registration, and Python log parsing; validated against the dissertation dataset.

title: Malware Detection with ML
description: Linear SVM vs LightGBM vs a PyTorch MLP for static PE malware classification on EMBER 2018. LightGBM led with F1 0.9474 and ROC AUC 0.9892; ranking stability verified across two stratified subsets.

title: Heart Disease Classifier
description: Logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost on the UCI Heart Disease dataset, evaluated with stratified 5-fold cross-validation, calibration curves, ROC analysis, and McNemar's testing.

title: Web App Security Scanner
description: Python scanner that enumerates links and forms on target web applications and tests for reflected XSS. Built and tested against Metasploitable in an isolated lab.

title: Password Breach Checker
description: Checks passwords against the Have I Been Pwned Pwned Passwords API using k-Anonymity, so no plaintext password ever leaves the machine.

title: Hacker News Scraper
description: Web scraper that extracts top-voted Hacker News stories, filters by vote threshold, and delivers a clean, ranked daily digest by email.

title: ML Security Experiments
description: Self-directed experiments. Prompt-injection detection: TF-IDF classifiers hit 0.95+ accuracy within one dataset but dropped to 0.61–0.72 on another, while sentence-transformer embeddings transferred better. IoT intrusion detection on CIC IoT: LightGBM macro-F1 0.88, explained with SHAP.

title: IT Service Desk Lab
description: iTop ITSM ticketing deployed in Docker, plus a Microsoft Intune lab tenant with an Android phone enrolled under an Android Enterprise work profile.

title: This Portfolio
description: Flask backend with a markdown-powered blog engine, CSRF-protected contact form, and rate limiting. Deployed on Render.
